claims.text: Dry eyes: preservative-free drops (initially hypromellose or methylcellulose) + an OTC ointment at bedtime;
claims.quote: Dry eyes should be treated with preservative-free eye drops (initially drops such as hypromellose or methylcellulose and an over-the-counter ointment at bedtime).

claims.text: also topical cyclosporine, occasionally topical corticosteroids (ophthalmology)
claims.quote: Other treatments include drainage (punctal) duct closure and topical cyclosporine and occasionally topical corticosteroids (under the care of ophthalmology).

claims.text: Severe extraglandular dz (eg, cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, neuropathy, severe lung involvement, refractory arthritis): corticosteroids (eg, oral prednisone 1 mg/kg once a day) or rituximab
claims.quote: Corticosteroids (eg, oral prednisone 1 mg/kg once a day) or rituximab may be needed in severe disease with cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, peripheral neuropathy/multiple mononeuropathy, severe lung involvement, or inflammatory arthritis that does not respond to other therapy.
